pitta_dominant.title: 7-Day Pitta-Acne Plan — Cooling & Anti-Inflammatory
pitta_dominant.overview: Your Prakriti is Pitta dominant. Your acne is caused by excess internal heat and inflammation — not just surface bacteria. This plan cools Pitta from inside and outside simultaneously.

routine: Drink 1 glass rose water + 5 drops lemon on empty stomach — cools Pitta immediately
Apply fresh aloe vera gel all over face — leave 20 min
Wash with besan + rose water face wash (cold water only)
Apply sandalwood + rose water paste on active pimples as spot treatment
procedure: 1. Mix 1 glass rose water with 5 drops of fresh lemon juice. Drink on empty stomach.
2. Scoop out fresh aloe vera gel from a leaf (or use pure store-bought gel). Apply a thin layer all over clean face.
3. Leave for 20 minutes, then rinse with cold water.
4. Mix 2 tsp besan with enough rose water to form a smooth paste. Use as face wash with cold water. Rinse thoroughly.
5. Mix 1 tsp sandalwood powder with rose water to a thick paste. Apply only on active pimples as spot treatment. Leave overnight or 30 min.

diet.breakfast: Moong dal cheela with mint chutney — light and cooling
diet.lunch: Brown rice + palak dal + cucumber raita — no spice
diet.dinner: Light moong dal khichdi with pinch turmeric

routine: Steam face with neem water 5 min — opens pores
Apply turmeric + sandalwood + rose water mask — leave 20 min
Apply aloe vera gel as night moisturizer
procedure: 1. Boil 5-6 neem leaves in 2 cups water for 5 minutes. Cool to a comfortable temperature. Hold face over the steam for 5 minutes, keeping eyes closed.
2. Mix 1 tsp turmeric powder + 1 tsp sandalwood powder + enough rose water to make a smooth paste.
3. Apply evenly on face avoiding eye area. Leave for 20 minutes.
4. Rinse with cold water and pat face dry gently.
5. Apply a thin layer of aloe vera gel as a night moisturizer. Leave on overnight.

days.yoga: Sheetali Pranayama — 10 rounds. Inhale through rolled tongue, exhale through nose. Directly cools Pitta.
days.tip: Pitta acne is always heat-driven. Every cold water rinse, every cooling food, every Sheetali breath directly reduces your acne trigger.

routine: Drink amla juice — 30ml diluted in water (highest Vitamin C, cools blood)
Apply chilled cucumber slices on inflamed pimples 10 min
Besan face wash with cold water
Apply 2 drops tea tree oil diluted in aloe vera on spots only
procedure: 1. Dilute 30ml amla juice in half a glass of water. Drink immediately on empty stomach.
2. Slice a chilled cucumber and place slices directly on inflamed pimples. Leave for 10 minutes.
3. Mix 2 tsp besan with cold water to a runny paste. Massage on face for 1 minute in gentle circles. Rinse with cold water.
4. Mix 2 drops tea tree oil with 1 tsp aloe vera gel. Using a cotton bud, apply only on individual pimples — not full face.

diet.lunch: Roti + any green vegetable + dal — no tomato today
diet.dinner: Vegetable soup — no spice, add coriander leaves

routine: Apply multani mitti + rose water mask on T-zone
Leave 15 min — remove before fully dry
procedure: 1. Mix 2 tsp multani mitti with enough rose water to form a thick paste.
2. Apply only on the T-zone (forehead, nose, chin). Avoid dry areas.
3. Leave for 15 minutes — remove before it fully dries to avoid cracking.
4. Rinse with cold water and pat dry.
5. Apply a thin layer of aloe vera gel as moisturizer.

days.yoga: Sitali Pranayama 5 min + Moon salutation 5 rounds — both cool Pitta fire.
days.tip: Manjistha is the number one Ayurvedic blood purifier for Pitta acne. Drink as tea daily this week.

routine: Oil pulling with coconut oil 10 min — removes heat toxins
Neem + tulsi paste on face — leave 15 min
Rose water toner on cotton pad
procedure: 1. Take 1 tbsp coconut oil in your mouth. Swish around for 10 minutes without swallowing. Spit out into a bin — not the sink.
2. Grind 4-5 fresh neem leaves and 4-5 fresh tulsi leaves together with a few drops of water to form a paste.
3. Apply the paste on face. Leave for 15 minutes.
4. Rinse with cold water.
5. Dab rose water on a cotton pad and wipe face gently as a toner.

diet.breakfast: Oats with coconut milk + saffron strands
diet.lunch: Brown rice + dal + steamed vegetables — minimal oil
drinks: warm water with 1 tsp triphala before bed

routine: Apply besan + turmeric + raw milk mask
Sandalwood powder + rose water spot treatment
procedure: 1. Mix 2 tsp besan + 1/2 tsp turmeric powder + enough raw milk to form a smooth paste.
2. Apply evenly on face and neck. Leave for 20 minutes.
3. Rinse with cold water.
4. Mix 1 tsp sandalwood powder with rose water to a paste. Apply as a spot treatment on marks and active pimples only.

days.yoga: Bhujangasana 5 rounds + Kapalbhati 5 min — improves blood circulation, reduces heat accumulation.
days.tip: Drink minimum 10 glasses of water today. For Pitta, water is medicine — it dilutes and cools excess heat.

routine: Warm water with 1 tsp honey + rose water
Gentle coconut oil massage on face 3 min
procedure: 1. Mix 1 tsp honey into a glass of warm water. Add a splash of rose water. Drink slowly.
2. Warm 1 tsp coconut oil slightly. Massage gently on face for 3 minutes in upward circular motions.
3. Mix 2 tsp besan with water and use to wash the oil off. Rinse thoroughly with warm water.
4. Apply a thin layer of aloe vera gel as moisturizer.

diet.breakfast: Banana + soaked oats with coconut milk
diet.lunch: Dal tadka (cumin only, no red chili) + roti + boiled vegetables
diet.dinner: Light vegetable khichdi + warm glass milk

routine: Apply chilled green tea toner using cotton pad
Honey + cinnamon spot treatment on pimples only (1:4 ratio)
Leave honey overnight — do not rinse
procedure: 1. Brew green tea, cool to room temperature. Dip a cotton pad in chilled green tea and apply as a toner all over face.
2. Mix honey and cinnamon in ratio 4:1 (4 parts honey, 1 part cinnamon). Apply only on individual pimples using a cotton bud.
3. Leave overnight — do not rinse. The honey will work as an overnight antibacterial spot treatment.

days.yoga: Legs up the wall pose 10 min — reduces stress hormones that trigger Pitta acne.
days.tip: Sleep before 10:30 PM. Pitta is most active 10 PM to 2 AM — late sleep directly worsens Pitta acne.

routine: Raw potato juice on acne marks — leave 20 min
procedure: 1. Mix 30ml amla juice with a few fresh mint leaves (or mint juice). Drink on empty stomach.
2. Grate a raw potato and squeeze out the juice. Apply juice on acne marks using a cotton pad. Leave for 20 minutes.
3. Wash off with besan + warm water face wash. Rinse thoroughly.
4. Mix 1 tsp sandalwood powder with milk to a paste. Apply only on marks. Leave 20-30 minutes then rinse.

diet.breakfast: Fresh fruit bowl — papaya, apple, pomegranate
drinks: warm water with triphala before bed

routine: Multani mitti + neem powder + rose water mask
procedure: 1. Boil 5 neem leaves in water. Cool to steam temperature. Steam face for 5 minutes.
2. Mix 1 tsp multani mitti + 1 tsp neem powder + enough rose water to form a paste.
3. Apply on face. Leave for 20 minutes.
4. Rinse with cold water.
5. Dab rose water as toner using a cotton pad.

days.yoga: Anulom Vilom 10 min — directly balances Pitta and calms inflammation.
days.tip: Apply sunscreen SPF 30+ every morning without fail. UV rays are the biggest Pitta acne aggravator.

routine: Warm water + honey + lemon (5 drops only)
Fresh neem leaf paste on face — leave 20 min
2 drops lavender oil in aloe vera as moisturizer
procedure: 1. Mix 1 tsp honey + 5 drops lemon juice into warm water. Drink on empty stomach.
2. Grind 6-7 fresh neem leaves with a few drops of water to a smooth paste.
3. Apply on face. Leave for 20 minutes.
4. Rinse with cold water.
5. Mix 2 drops lavender oil into 1 tsp aloe vera gel. Apply as moisturizer.

diet.lunch: Full thali — roti + 2 non-spicy sabzis + dal + raita

routine: Warm 2 tbsp sesame oil + pinch turmeric
procedure: 1. Mix 2 tsp sesame oil with a pinch of turmeric. Warm slightly.
2. Massage face with upward strokes for 5 minutes.
3. Leave for 15 minutes.
4. Wash off with mild besan face wash.
5. Apply a thin layer of aloe vera gel.

days.yoga: Sheetali + Bhramari Pranayama 5 min each — most effective pranayama combination for Pitta skin.
days.tip: Add 2 drops tea tree oil to your regular face wash permanently — ongoing antibacterial protection.

routine: Permanent morning drink: coriander seed water OR amla juice
Permanent face wash: besan + rose water
procedure: 1. Drink coriander seed water or amla juice on empty stomach.
2. Mix 2 tsp besan + rose water to a runny paste. Use as face wash. Rinse with cold water.
3. Apply pure aloe vera gel as moisturizer.
4. Apply SPF 30+ sunscreen before stepping out. Do not skip.

avoid: permanent avoidance: spicy food, fried food, alcohol, coffee excess, late night eating

routine: Weekly Sunday mask: turmeric + sandalwood + aloe vera
Spot treatment: sandalwood paste on marks
procedure: 1. Weekly Sunday mask: Mix 1 tsp turmeric + 1 tsp sandalwood + enough aloe vera gel to form a paste. Apply for 20 minutes, rinse cold.
2. Daily night: Apply a thin layer of aloe vera gel as moisturizer.
3. For active marks: apply sandalwood + rose water paste as spot treatment.

days.yoga: Sheetali Pranayama 5 min every morning permanently — your daily Pitta cooling practice.
days.tip: Results show in 3-4 weeks. Continue: no spicy food + coriander water morning + aloe vera daily.

weekly_summary.continue_after_7_days: Coriander water every morning. No spicy food. Aloe vera daily. Sheetali pranayama daily.

kapha_dominant.title: 7-Day Kapha-Acne Plan — Detox & Deep Cleanse
kapha_dominant.overview: Your Prakriti is Kapha dominant. Your acne is caused by excess oil and toxin buildup blocking follicles — not heat. This plan detoxifies, reduces oil production, and stimulates circulation.

routine: Drink warm water + 1 tsp honey + ginger juice 5 drops — activates detox
Oil pulling with sesame oil 10 min
Apply neem + turmeric + besan scrub paste — gently exfoliate
procedure: 1. Mix 1 tsp honey + 5 drops ginger juice in warm water. Drink on empty stomach.
2. Take 1 tbsp sesame oil. Swish in mouth for 10 minutes. Spit into bin.
3. Mix 1 tsp neem powder + 1/2 tsp turmeric + 2 tsp besan with water to a paste. Apply on face. Gently exfoliate in circles for 2 minutes.
4. Rinse with cold water to close pores.

diet.breakfast: Sprouts salad + ginger lemon tea (no milk)
diet.lunch: Jowar roti + methi sabzi + moong dal
diet.dinner: Light vegetable soup with black pepper and ginger
drinks: ginger lemon warm water throughout day

routine: Steam face 8 min with neem water
Multani mitti + neem powder + apple cider vinegar mask — leave 20 min
procedure: 1. Boil 5 neem leaves in water. Cool to steam temperature. Steam face for 8 minutes.
2. Mix 1 tsp multani mitti + 1 tsp neem powder + 1 tsp apple cider vinegar (diluted 1:2 with water).
3. Apply on face. Leave for 20 minutes.
4. Rinse with lukewarm water first, then cold water.
5. Dab rose water as toner using a cotton pad.

days.yoga: Kapalbhati Pranayama 10 min — best practice for Kapha detox. Do daily all week.
days.tip: Kapha acne is oil and toxin driven. Sweating through yoga is medicine — it clears pores naturally.

routine: Besan + lemon (3 drops) + turmeric face wash
Apply witch hazel toner on oily areas
procedure: 1. Soak 1 tsp triphala powder in warm water overnight. Drink the strained water first thing in the morning.
2. Mix 2 tsp besan + 3 drops lemon juice + 1/2 tsp turmeric + water to a paste. Use as face wash.
3. Dab witch hazel toner on oily areas using a cotton pad.
4. Apply a thin layer of aloe vera gel as oil-free moisturizer.

diet.lunch: Brown rice + bitter gourd sabzi + dal

routine: Activated charcoal + aloe vera mask on T-zone only
Ice cube wrapped in cloth on nose and chin 2 min
procedure: 1. Mix 1 tsp activated charcoal powder with 1 tsp aloe vera gel to a paste.
2. Apply only on T-zone (nose and forehead). Leave for 15 minutes.
3. Rinse thoroughly with water.
4. Wrap an ice cube in a clean cloth. Dab on nose and chin for 2 minutes.
5. Apply witch hazel toner with a cotton pad.

days.yoga: Surya Namaskar 10 rounds — generates heat that melts Kapha and opens pores through sweat.
days.tip: Wash face maximum twice daily. Over-washing signals more oil production in Kapha skin.

routine: Neem leaf paste on face — leave 20 min
2 drops tea tree oil diluted in aloe vera
procedure: 1. Boil 4 neem leaves + 4 tulsi leaves in water. Strain and drink as tea.

3. Apply on face. Leave for 20 minutes.
4. Rinse with cold water.
5. Mix 2 drops tea tree oil in 1 tsp aloe vera gel. Apply on active pimples only.

routine: Egg white + lemon juice peel mask on T-zone
Leave until dry — 20 min — peel gently
procedure: 1. Separate 1 egg white from yolk. Beat until slightly frothy.
2. Add 5 drops lemon juice to the egg white. Mix well.
3. Apply on T-zone. Leave until completely dry, about 20 minutes.
4. Peel off gently or rinse with cold water.
5. Apply rose water then witch hazel toner on cotton pads.

days.yoga: Bhastrika Pranayama 5 min + Kapalbhati 10 min — generates internal heat to burn Kapha toxins.
days.tip: Bitter gourd (karela) juice 3 times this week — reduces excess oil from inside the body.

routine: Aloe vera juice with warm water
Turmeric + besan + yogurt face wash (yogurt reduces for oily — use minimal)
procedure: 1. Mix 1 tsp aloe vera juice in a glass of warm water. Drink on empty stomach.
2. Mix 1/2 tsp turmeric + 2 tsp besan + 1 tsp plain yogurt (minimal). Use as face wash.
3. Apply rose water toner with a cotton pad.
4. Apply a thin layer of aloe vera gel as oil-free moisturizer.

routine: Tomato juice + honey on pimple areas
Multani mitti spot mask on large pimples overnight
procedure: 1. Extract juice from half a fresh tomato. Mix with 1 tsp honey.
2. Apply on pimple areas using a cotton pad. Leave for 15 minutes.
3. Rinse with cold water.
4. Apply multani mitti paste directly on large pimples as a spot mask. Leave overnight.

days.yoga: Trikonasana + Kapalbhati combo — stimulates liver detox which directly clears Kapha skin.
days.tip: Clean your mobile screen daily — it presses against your cheek and transfers bacteria to Kapha skin.

routine: Rice flour + besan + rose water gentle scrub — 2 min circular motion

2. Mix 1 tsp rice flour + 1 tsp besan + enough rose water for a scrub paste.
3. Apply on face and massage in gentle circular motions for 2 minutes.
4. Rinse with cold water.
5. Apply rose water toner then aloe vera gel.

routine: Neem powder + multani mitti + rose water full face mask
procedure: 1. Mix 1 tsp neem powder + 1 tsp multani mitti + enough rose water for a smooth paste.
2. Apply all over face. Leave for 20 minutes.
3. Rinse with cold water.
4. Apply a thin layer of aloe vera gel.

days.yoga: Matsyasana + Kapalbhati — thyroid stimulation through fish pose balances Kapha skin hormones.
days.tip: Apply neem oil 2 drops diluted in aloe vera on stubborn pimples — strongest antibacterial for Kapha acne.

procedure: 1. Mix 1 tsp moringa powder in warm water. Stir and drink.

4. Apply a thin layer of aloe vera gel as oil-free moisturizer.

diet.lunch: Full balanced meal — minimal oil, no fried

routine: Sandalwood + turmeric + rose water paste on acne marks
procedure: 1. Mix 1 tsp sandalwood powder + 1/2 tsp turmeric + rose water to a paste.
2. Apply on acne marks. Leave for 20 minutes.
3. Rinse with cold water.

days.yoga: Anulom Vilom 15 min — balances Kapha and Pitta together.
days.tip: Tie hair back at night — hair oil and products touch your face while sleeping and worsen Kapha acne.

routine: Permanent Kapha morning drink: warm ginger lemon water
Permanent face wash: besan + neem powder + rose water
procedure: 1. Drink warm ginger lemon water on empty stomach.
2. Mix 2 tsp besan + 1 tsp neem powder + rose water to paste. Use as daily face wash.
3. Apply witch hazel toner with a cotton pad.
4. Apply aloe vera gel as moisturizer.

drinks: ginger lemon water every morning permanently
avoid: permanently: excess dairy, sugar, fried food, cold drinks

routine: Weekly Sunday: multani mitti + neem mask
Daily night: witch hazel toner + aloe vera
Spot treatment: tea tree oil diluted on active pimples
